localChanges: A stack of units no longer leaves a sliver of the unit behind it on the squares above and to its left when the stack moves on or breaks up, and a unit moving next to a stack no longer cuts the edge off it (closes #486).

A city no longer leaves a sliver on the squares to its right and below when it changes, and the last column of worked-square icons is no longer cut off at the edge of its square or left behind on the square to its right.
City names that overlap a neighbouring city's name no longer turn bolder and ragged each time one of the two cities changes.
